title: Goodbye
summary: Interviewer wraps up and says goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: I think our town is just about to run out. I think it'll make a good story and everything. I hope it will. Maybe something will come out of it someday. We never know. We'll turn up. See ya. Bye-bye. Bye-bye. Bye-bye. Bye-bye.
